title: Leaving Laplace for New Orleans at 21
summary: Ory left on his twenty-first birthday, Christmas 1907, and never lived in Laplace again.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Now, tell me. When you were 21 years old, exactly, you left Laplace and moved... Is that right? Moved to New Orleans. That's right. The very day.
